pages.text: After you transcended into undeath and obtained the Green Smith's green apple, you began to wonder how to craft a wither with formidable necromantic power.$(br)Fortunately, with the knowledge of the Forbidden Scroll, you found a way to obtain this powerful wither variant.

The Nameless Wither can fire Nameless Bolts, summon clones and use corruption focuses, and can grow in power by slaying enemies.$(br)You may also give it Unholy Blood, a Broken Reaper Scythe, Coffin Fragments, a Green Apple or a Nether Star to empower it (see the Nameless Wither skill entry).
You can also feed it any Soul Jar to restore 100 health, or feed it bones to restore a small amount of health.
